parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, clean acceptance of foreign documents at the border, no documented police sweeps, extortion or organised targeting — that keeps it out of the high-risk band, and no violence campaign is shown. But several unremedied state-imposed universal exposures stack up: the 2025 top-court ruling reads 'sex' in the equality act as biological sex, and the statutory single-sex-spaces code in force since 5 Aug 2026 supplies providers with compliance examples excluding trans people from changing rooms, hostels and single-sex accommodation; the only challenge is at pre-action, and UN experts flag institutionalised discrimination. Strip-searches run on biological sex (transport police; one regional force). Regional prison guidance was struck down toward birth-sex segregation. Hospital ward exclusion is documented with an avoidable death (Joelle) and official threat-framing of ward access. Courts are enforcing exclusion, not remedying it. Multiple tier-1 exposures place this below the single-exposure 0.45 anchors, near the 0.35 tier.
